capabilities: Auto-sort marked list regions five seconds after edits
Sort tables by header, position, or a named column
Sort task lists by checkbox status
Wrap the current selection with keep-sorted markers
Re-sort all marked blocks across the vault
disambiguation: Not a general text formatter; it only sorts the regions you explicitly wrap in keep-sorted markers.
extras: Adds three options beyond Google's keep-sorted (nested, column, key) and does not support all of Google's other options, such as duplicate removal.
intentEvidence: The idea and the keep-sorted start / keep-sorted end markers come from Google's keep-sorted
motivation: The author wanted to bring Google's keep-sorted marker convention to Obsidian notes, using Obsidian comments for the markers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep list or table regions in a note sorted automatically as they are edited.

relations.evidence: This plugin brings the same convention to Obsidian notes, using Obsidian comments for the markers

summary: Auto-sorts list and table blocks wrapped in keep-sorted comment markers, using the same marker convention as Google's keep-sorted formatter.
